vocabulary.definition: a person who lives in a particular place
vocabulary.example: The new resident of the apartment building introduced herself to the neighbors.

vocabulary.definition: an artificial waterway constructed to allow the passage of boats or ships inland or to convey water for irrigation.
vocabulary.example: The famous Panama Canal connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean.

vocabulary.definition: coming into existence; starting or beginning
vocabulary.example: The river originating from the mountain flows through the valley.

vocabulary.definition: extremely comfortable, elegant, or enjoyable, especially in a way that involves great expense
vocabulary.example: The hotel suite was decorated in a luxurious style with plush furniture.

vocabulary.definition: the outer parts of a town or city
vocabulary.example: The outskirts of the city have more green spaces compared to the busy downtown area.

vocabulary.definition: exceptional intellectual or creative power or other natural ability
vocabulary.example: Leonardo da Vinci was a genius whose works continue to amaze people centuries later.
